title: Human mathematicians are being outcounterexampled
summary: This blog post discusses how AI systems are now surpassing human mathematicians in finding counterexamples to conjectures, marking a significant shift in mathematical research capabilities. The title uses clever wordplay - 'outcounterexampled' means having more and better counterexamples produced against your work than you produce against others.
problem_solved: The challenge of efficiently discovering counterexamples that disprove mathematical conjectures, which traditionally required extensive human intuition and trial-and-error.
why_valuable: Demonstrates AI's growing capability to contribute meaningfully to pure mathematical research, potentially accelerating discovery in number theory, combinatorics, and other fields.
